name: Randoseru Syndrome
original_name: ランドセルシンドローム
source:
When we turn 20, adulthood closes in on us.
But it's not like we really feel like we've grown up the instant that happens.

So, when will I become and adult?

＊　＊　＊

It's about a 30 minute ride on the gently rocking train away from the heart of the city.
This town on the water's edge has it's own kind of charm, different from the city with its lines of buildings.

Development was progressing, and an "amusement park" had been built on this once empty land overlooking the sea.

The landmark "Ferris Wheel" was starting to greatly color the impression of the town.

＊　＊　＊

Right before summer vacation, third year student Tobari Youichi has stayed behind after classes are over. He was worrying about his future and what to do after high school, unable to find an answer.

Before he realizes it, it is evening and he is still at school. When he opens his eyes a lone girl- Kaigara Kamome- is standing there. 

"I wrote 'I want to become an adult' on your career survey and turned it in." Kamome tells him, as if it were an obvious thing to do.

Although Youichi is shocked by the impulsive actions of this girl, whose name he doesn't even know, he doesn't object. 
He doesn't mind being able to put off answering that question.

A few days after their chance meeting, Youichi runs into her again in the empty classroom.
She tells him that even though she's decided what she's doing after high school, she keeps re-writing her answer over and over.

"I want to become a magician."
"...of course, I don't mean that in a fantasy way."

Even though her dream for the future is absurd, Yuichi starts to become interested in Kamome, who is trying to be honest to her own feelings. 

A faithful depiction of boys and girls who have grown too big for their Randoseru backpacks.
A story of 'angels' and 'magic' that may have happened in this seaside town in mid-summer.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210513230018/http://randro.mochioto.com/story.html]Homepage[/url]]
translation:
年满20岁，成年人的生活便向我们逼近。
可这不代表一到20岁，我们就真的觉得自己长大了。

那么，我什么时候才能成为大人？

＊　＊　＊

离市中心约半小时车程，有一列轻轻摇晃的电车。这座临水小镇有着不同于高楼林立的大城市的独特魅力。

随着开发推进，人们在这片曾经空旷、俯瞰大海的土地上建起了一座“游乐园”。

作为地标的“摩天轮”，正逐渐为小镇增添鲜明色彩。

＊　＊　＊

暑假前夕，高三学生帐阳一在放学后留在学校。他对未来和高中毕业后的去向感到烦恼，却找不到答案。

不知不觉间天色已晚，他仍留在学校。睁开眼时，一个女孩独自站在眼前——贝壳海鸥。

“我在你的升学调查表上写了‘想成为大人’，然后交上去了。”海鸥理所当然地告诉他。

阳一对这个连名字都不知道的女孩擅自替自己填写感到震惊，却没有反对。他并不介意暂时把那个问题搁置一旁。

偶遇几天后，阳一又在空荡荡的教室里遇见她。她说自己虽然已经决定高中毕业后要做什么，却总是一遍又一遍地改写答案。

“我想成为魔法师。”
“……当然，我不是指幻想里的那种。”

她的未来梦想虽然荒唐，阳一却开始对努力忠于内心的海鸥产生兴趣。

真实描绘背着小学生书包都嫌太大的男孩与女孩。

这是一个关于盛夏海滨小镇里或许曾发生过的“天使”与“魔法”的故事。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210513230018/http://randro.mochioto.com/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
